What it does: Authenticates a user and establishes the HireScope session without a local password store.
Steward Capability: StewardSignIn: authorization-code flow with PKCE, sign-in check, and refresh/session helpers
Request packet: StewardSignIn.start() authorization request; callback code exchange through StewardSignIn.finish()
Answer packet: Authenticated identity, permitted businesses, viewer and refresh tokens, or a documented sign-in refusal
Event packet: module.disabled ends sessions for that business; role changes are rechecked on refresh
How it maps to Steward: Use the Steward PKCE callback, create a HireScope session only after the sign-in check succeeds, and pass the Steward viewer token on authorised calls.
HireScope Responsibility: Validate the returned session, bind it to the tenant context, enforce application authorization, and audit denied access.
Dependencies: Steward linked-module enablement; registered redirect URI; authorization middleware
Human responsibility: Organisation Admin and authorised staff establish their own session; HireScope enforces access.
AI responsibility and limits: AI takes no part in authentication or access decisions.

What it does: The Pente Organisation Admin initiates staff invitation/registration through the approved identity path. HireScope never creates a duplicate credential account.
Event packet: role.changed can indicate that a person's business access changed
HireScope Responsibility: Keep only application participant references and pending workflow invitations; never store passwords.
Dependencies: Pente-managed member identity and invitation process; role mapping
Human responsibility: Organisation Admin invites and manages staff membership; HireScope never creates credentials.

Feature: Configure recruitment workflow templates and guardrails
What it does: The Pente Organisation Owner defines reusable stage templates, evidence/rubric templates, allowed stage order, timing/attempt defaults, panel requirements, and weights. Hiring Managers may refine an approved template per requisition but cannot bypass Owner guardrails. Hiring Reviewer recommends and Hiring Approver makes every progression decision. HR communicates applicant-facing outcomes only.
How it maps to Steward: No Steward recruitment-configuration capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own settings/version model, Owner-only administration, default inheritance, change history, and prevention of retroactive changes to active applicant stages.
Dependencies: Fixed Pente owner; requisition/opening versioning; policy middleware
Human responsibility: Organisation Owner configures guardrails; Hiring Reviewer reviews evidence; Hiring Approver makes required decisions; HR sends applicant communications.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may draft or summarise only. It cannot change a candidate state, approve a workflow, or replace a human review.

Feature: Configure assessment and interview delivery policy
What it does: The Pente Organisation Owner enables the permitted assessment/interview modes, readiness and consent requirements, audio recording rules, retry limits, accommodation defaults, and live-interview panel rules. Video assessment/interview recording is explicitly unavailable in this scope.
How it maps to Steward: No Steward assessment-delivery configuration capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own Owner-only settings, versioning, opening inheritance, consent policy, and hard disablement of video configuration.
Dependencies: Fixed Pente owner; assessment configuration; privacy policy
Human responsibility: Organisation Owner configures policy; Hiring Reviewer reviews and recommends; Hiring Approver approves its use where required.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may draft policy text only; it cannot enable a delivery mode or waive consent.

What it does: Ensures every read and mutation is scoped to Pente and unauthorised/cross-context access is denied and audited; no multi-business selection is offered in this release.
How it maps to Steward: Resolve actor identity/roles from Steward; do notinfer scope from UI input.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce the fixed Pente scope and object relationships in every API/query; append denial audit.
Dependencies: Pente membership mapping; policy middleware
Human responsibility: System administrators configure tenant controls; authorised staff work only in their tenant scope.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot make or alter access or tenant decisions.

What it does: Recognises authorised Organisation Admin, Organisation Owner, HR, Hiring Manager, Hiring Reviewer, Hiring Approver, and Interviewer access without recreating Steward role management.
How it maps to Steward: Read current module roles and consume signed role-change events; reconcile the application's scoped authorization projection.
HireScope Responsibility: Map Steward role identifiers to HireScope permissions and job-opening assignments; keep workflow assignments separate.
Dependencies: Steward role contract; membership mapping
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer has review/recommend authority; Hiring Approver has approval/decision authority; HR can communicate with applicants but cannot review or approve.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot grant, revoke or alter access.

Feature: Read staff, units, and reporting lines
What it does: Supplies current organisation people, departments/units, and manager relationships for approvers, panel selection, and employee context.

Answer packet: PeopleList; UnitList; paginated dated reporting-line list

HireScope Responsibility: Use the returned people only where recruitment requires them; constrain results to authorised tenant/workflow context.
Dependencies: Steward directory access; organisation mapping
Human responsibility: Authorised users select eligible people, units, and managers for workflow assignments.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may not infer reporting lines or assign people.

What it does: The Pente Organisation Admin views member status and maintains active/inactive recruitment membership, including a reasoned deactivation/reinstatement. The admin cannot change Organisation Owner settings or make candidate decisions.
Steward Capability: listPeople; listModuleRoles; role.changed; module_roles.changed. No member-write operation is documented for attached modules.
How it maps to Steward: Read current people and module roles from Steward and consume the signed events. Keep HireScope access effects as an application projection; do not create an independent member directory or assume a member-update API.
HireScope Responsibility: Own HireScope staff-to-workflow references, job-specific access effects, deactivation consequences, and audit projection.
Dependencies: Pente-managed membership; Steward directory/role reads; audit
Human responsibility: Organisation Admin activates, deactivates, or reinstates recruitment members with a reason.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot activate, deactivate or reinstate a member.

Feature: Approve or revoke recruitment role access
What it does: The Pente Organisation Admin approves/rejects authorised HR or Hiring Manager access requests and revokes organisation-level recruitment access with a reason; job-specific interviewer access remains created only by the approved opening/panel workflow.
Steward Capability: listModuleRoles; module_roles.changed; askPerson. Steward business owners or admins assign module roles in Steward; no module role-write API is documented.

Answer packet: ModuleRoleList; ask answer via getAsk; no module role-write response
How it maps to Steward: Use an ask only to gather a review response. Apply a role change through Steward's owner/admin interface, then consume module_roles.changed; do not treat an ask as an authority change.
HireScope Responsibility: Own the access-request record, evidence, decision UI, workflow-scope validation, revocation impact, and audit history.
Dependencies: Pente member; Steward owner/admin role administration; job-opening assignment rules
Human responsibility: A Steward business owner or admin approves or revokes module-role access; workflow roles remain assignment-scoped.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot approve, reject, grant or revoke access.

Feature: Assign or revoke Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver roles
What it does: Grants or revokes the Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver roles for recruitment workflow assignments, with a required reason and no self-assignment.
Steward Capability: listModuleRoles; module_roles.changed. Steward business owners or admins assign module roles in Steward; no module role-write API is documented.
Request packet: listModuleRoles request; no module role-write request
How it maps to Steward: Read current module roles and consume signed role-change events. Keep the required reason, no-self-assignment rule, and opening-specific separation-of-duties checks in HireScope.
HireScope Responsibility: Own role-assignment records, required reason, no self-assignment rule, and audit history.
Dependencies: Pente member; Steward owner/admin role administration
Human responsibility: A Steward business owner or admin assigns with a reason; no self-assignment.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot assign, grant or revoke roles.

Feature: Configure retention, legal hold, and audit policy
What it does: Defines retention rules and legal holds for recruitment records; holds override scheduled deletion.
In Steward: Partial - audit and sealed-record support only
Steward Capability: createAudit; fileRecord for declared sealed PDF records; createDeletionReceipt for deletion duties concerning module-held data. Steward legal hold can defer a deletion duty, but no retention/legal-hold configuration API is documented.
Request packet: AuditRequest; RecordFiling + PDF; DeletionReceiptRequest referencing the deletion event
Event packet: business.purged and module.disabled can create deletion duties; legal hold defers delete-mode delivery
How it maps to Steward: Append cross-system governance events, file only declared final PDF record kinds, and send deletion receipts only after deleting module-held data. Do not claim that Steward configures or retains all HireScope records.
HireScope Responsibility: Own record retention schedule, legal-hold access restrictions, purge jobs, and domain audit events.
Dependencies: Retention policy; legal review; object storage
Human responsibility: Organisation Owner and authorised legal/compliance staff define retention and legal-hold rules.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot configure retention, place a hold, or delete records.

Feature: Define human review and AI decision boundaries
What it does: Defines the sister-module workflow: Steward assigns, tracks, and audits human review/approval tasks and provides the metered AI gateway; HireScope owns recruitment state, evidence, gates, and applicant-facing workflow. Every AI output is advisory and every review, approval, progression, selection, exception, and cancellation decision has an accountable human actor, except the rule-based automatic cancellation of an unattempted assessment, whose accountable actor is the Owner-configured policy executed by the system, with a mandatory reason code.
Request packet: CompletionRequest; ProposalRequest; getProposal request; AuditRequest; askPerson request; getAsk request
Answer packet: Completion; Proposal; Proposal; AuditReceipt; askPerson answer; getAsk answer
How it maps to Steward: Create Steward tasks/proposals for Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver, preserve task/audit status, and invoke approved AI through the Steward gateway only.
HireScope Responsibility: Own role-based task creation, immutable recommendation/decision records, decision gates, applicant-state transitions, and correlation to Steward task/audit IDs. Enforce separation of duties: the same person cannot hold both recommend and approve on one item; a requisition creator cannot approve their own requisition; a declared conflict blocks evaluation.
Dependencies: Role mapping; task/proposal contract; audit policy; AI gateway
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer reviews evidence and submits a recommendation. Hiring Approver approves/rejects budget, senior-role, progression, selection, exception, and cancellation decisions. HR communicates approved applicant-facing outcomes only.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may extract, summarise, compare evidence, and produce advisory scores/flags. AI cannot approve, reject, select, advance, cancel, decide access, send applicant communications, or change a workflow state.

What it does: Captures workforce need, headcount, job information, criteria, stages, sections, questions, weights, role seniority flag, and approved budget amount.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned:
HireScope Responsibility: Own versioned requisition data, validations, draft state, raising-manager authority, role seniority flag, approved budget amount, and headcount.
Dependencies: Staff directory; requisition/version schema
Human responsibility: Hiring Manager creates the draft; Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver later review and approve it.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may assist with drafting only; it cannot submit or approve a requisition.

What it does: Drafts and edits the fair-pack/evidence areas, questions, stages, timing, attempts, modalities, and weights before approval.
Steward Capability: completeAi may be used for advisory drafting
How it maps to Steward: If AI drafting is enabled, call the metered Steward AI gateway; no AI output can decide a candidate or bypass review.
HireScope Responsibility: Own prompts/configuration, human edits, versioning, validation, and approved configuration lock. Create requisition draft holds the basic fields; this row holds the AI-assisted fair-pack, rubric, and configuration editing.
Dependencies: AI gateway; requisition configuration; Hiring Approver approval
Human responsibility: Hiring Manager drafts; Hiring Reviewer checks fairness and suitability; Hiring Approver approves the configuration.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may suggest draft content only; a human must edit and approve it.

What it does: For each role, configures whether background/reference verification is required after offer acceptance, the permitted verification scope, consent wording, and the onboarding gate. The approved policy is pinned to the requisition/opening.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned. Steward only carries the Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver review tasks through the requisition approval rows.
HireScope Responsibility: Own policy versioning, role-level enable/disable control, consent content, opening inheritance, and immutable policy reference on the offer.
Dependencies: Requisition configuration; privacy/legal policy; Hiring Approver authorization
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer checks the proposed policy; Hiring Approver approves it.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot enable, disable or approve a verification policy.

Feature: Submit requisition for Hiring Reviewer review
What it does: Locks the submitted version and routes it to a Hiring Reviewer for evidence, scope, and policy review without changing any previously approved version, if one exists.
How it maps to Steward: Create a Hiring Reviewer task or proposal in Steward; HireScope changes the requisition only after the authorised approval decision.
HireScope Responsibility: Create immutable submission version, review queue, SLA, recommendation history, and transition history.
Dependencies: Requisition draft; Hiring Reviewer role; notifications
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer reviews the requisition and records a recommendation.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may flag missing configuration or draft a summary. It cannot approve or return a requisition.

Feature: Approve, return, or withdraw requisition and budget
What it does: A Hiring Approver approves the requisition and budget, returns it with a reason, or the authorised creator withdraws it. Returned resubmissions create a new version.
Request packet: ProposalRequest; getProposal request; no Steward requisition-withdrawal request; AuditRequest
Answer packet: Proposal; Proposal; no Steward requisition-withdrawal response; AuditReceipt
How it maps to Steward: Use a Steward Hiring Approver approval task/proposal for approve or return; record creator withdrawal as a HireScope audit entry only; apply the decision in HireScope after acceptance.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce lifecycle transitions, immutable review/approval records, budget gate, return/resubmission, and creator-only withdrawal rules.
Dependencies: Requisition versions; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver authorization
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer verifies budget context and recommends; Hiring Approver approves the requisition and budget. The creator may withdraw their own draft or submitted requisition.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot approve, return or withdraw a requisition or budget.

What it does: Creates an opening only from an approved requisition and carries forward its approved configuration.
How it maps to Steward: No Steward opening capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own opening draft/version, requisition linkage, operational posting fields, target capacity, and inherited configuration.
Dependencies: Approved requisition; opening/version schema
Human responsibility: Hiring Manager creates the opening from an approved requisition.

What it does: Selects eligible employees for a specific opening/stage panel rather than granting broad interviewer access.
Request packet: listPeople request; listUnits request; listReportingLines request with optional as_of/cursor; listModuleRoles request
Answer packet: PeopleList; UnitList; paginated dated reporting-line list; ModuleRoleList
How it maps to Steward: Read employee directory/eligibility from Steward. Reporting-line names must be resolved from listPeople; module-role changes are performed by a Steward owner/admin, not by a module API.
HireScope Responsibility: Persist nominations, conflict/eligibility checks, stage scope, Hiring Reviewer eligibility check, and Hiring Approver approval requirement.
Dependencies: Opening draft; staff directory; Hiring Reviewer review
Human responsibility: Hiring Manager nominates. Hiring Reviewer checks eligibility/conflicts. Hiring Approver approves the panel.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may flag declared conflicts or missing panel coverage; it cannot appoint or approve interviewers.

Feature: Approve or return opening and panel package
What it does: Hiring Reviewer reviews the opening configuration and nominated panels. Hiring Approver approves or returns the package with a reason; return requires correction and resubmission.
Request packet: ProposalRequest; getProposal request; AuditRequest; askPerson request; getAsk request
Answer packet: Proposal; Proposal; AuditReceipt; askPerson answer; getAsk answer
How it maps to Steward: Route the Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver tasks through Steward and update the opening only after the approver decision.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce separate review and approval records, immutable history, return/resubmission, and the approved-to-publish gate.
Dependencies: Opening version; panel nominations; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver authorization
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer reviews the package. Hiring Approver makes the publish-gate decision. HR does not review or approve.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may provide an advisory completeness check only; it cannot approve, return, or publish.

What it does: After package approval, creates a restricted stage assignment and sends an invitation; expiry/replacement remains visible.
In Steward: Partial - role read and member notification only
Steward Capability: listModuleRoles; module_roles.changed; notifyMember. No module API is documented to assign roles or create a membership invitation.
How it maps to Steward: Keep the stage assignment and invitation lifecycle in HireScope. Use notifyMember only for an existing eligible business member; Steward owner/admin role changes arrive through module_roles.changed.
HireScope Responsibility: Own invitation record, 24-hour activation status, stage access, replacement flow, and audit trail.
Dependencies: Approved panel; in-app stage assignment; Steward notices configuration
Human responsibility: Hiring Manager activates approved assignments; interviewers accept their scoped task.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot activate or assign an interviewer.

What it does: The opening creator publishes the Hiring Approver-approved version to the configured channels; publication activates candidate intake.
How it maps to Steward: Optionally publish an internal board announcement; no public job-board posting connector is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Enforce creator-only publish, state transition, channel publication integrations, public opening page, and audit.
Dependencies: Approved opening; careers/job-board connectors
Human responsibility: The creator publishes only the approved version. Hiring Approver controls the approval gate.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot publish, unpublish, or approve an opening.

What it does: A Hiring Reviewer raises a controlled request and a Hiring Approver approves or rejects it with a reason. The creating Hiring Manager executes an approved action. HR communicates applicant-visible effects only.
How it maps to Steward: Use an ask to collect a named person's response and read it with getAsk; keep the controlled action, authority checks, and state change in HireScope.
HireScope Responsibility: Own action-request state, execution authority, opening lifecycle, reason, applicant effects, and communication outbox. On suspension, assessment deadlines and the 24-hour grievance window are paused, no automatic void occurs, open tasks are held, and evidence is preserved. On closure, active applicants follow the company non-proceed process.
Dependencies: Opening; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver and creator roles; audit
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer recommends, Hiring Approver decides, and the creator executes. HR sends the approved applicant message.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may identify downstream impact; it cannot suspend, reactivate, close, or notify applicants.

What it does: Shows only published active openings and candidate-safe job details.
How it maps to Steward: No public vacancy discovery capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own public search/detail endpoints, opening visibility, accessibility, and closing/suspension behavior.
Dependencies: Published opening; public web delivery
Human responsibility: Candidates discover vacancies; the opening owner controls which approved openings are published.

Feature: Create or select applicant workspace context
What it does: Associates an applicant with the Pente opening while keeping applicant profile, application, and employee membership distinct.
Steward Capability: Steward linked sign-in with PKCE; requestGuestKey/listGuestKeys/revokeGuestKey for an external person limited to a module-owned scope
Answer packet: Guest key with awaiting_approval/active lifecycle; guest identity and scope in the sign-in check
How it maps to Steward: Use a guest key only for a clearly defined HireScope applicant scope. The guest can use only HireScope's permitted scope and cannot read Steward business records; HireScope still owns the applicant profile and application model.
HireScope Responsibility: Own applicant profile/application separation, tenant scoping, opening eligibility, and applicant-safe access.
Dependencies: Linked-module guest registration; applicant-profile schema; owner/admin guest-key approval
Human responsibility: The applicant creates or selects their own workspace context; support staff assist only with identity issues.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot create an applicant identity or expand a guest's scope.

What it does: Captures the version-pinned intake form, candidate details, resume/documents, and consent.
Steward Capability: fileRecord may seal final legal artefacts, not intake storage
How it maps to Steward: Keep candidate documents in HireScope-authorised storage; use fileRecord only if legal policy calls for a sealed artefact.
HireScope Responsibility: Own application form/version, duplicate checks, document access control, consent, and application creation.
Dependencies: Published opening; document storage; privacy notice
Human responsibility: The applicant submits their own application, documents, and consent.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may not submit, alter, or decide an application.

What it does: Parses resume content into role-relevant facts for advisory review without using protected/context-only data as a score.
Steward Capability: completeAi; sendOutside for approved parser provider
How it maps to Steward: Route AI/provider calls through Steward gateway/relay where enabled; retain only permitted evidence and provider correlation.
HireScope Responsibility: Own parser orchestration, evidence model, confidence/failure handling, human review, and privacy controls.
Dependencies: Applicant document; AI/provider; evidence policy
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer validates extracted facts before relying on them.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may extract role-relevant facts only; it must not score protected information or decide eligibility.

What it does: Flags possible duplicate profiles or applications for controlled Hiring Reviewer resolution without silently merging records.
How it maps to Steward: No Steward candidate-resolution capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own matching rules, Hiring Reviewer recommendation and Hiring Approver approval UI, merge/link audit, and privacy-safe candidate communication.
Dependencies: Applicant profiles; applications; Hiring Reviewer role
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer reviews and recommends link, merge, or cancel. Hiring Approver approves any merge or cancellation with a reason. HR communicates the approved outcome only.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may flag similarity only. It cannot merge profiles or cancel an application.

What it does: Compares submitted evidence to configured criteria and records advisory flags; AI never qualifies, rejects, advances, or selects.
How it maps to Steward: Use metered AI calls for advisory output only; capture usage/correlation through the gateway.
HireScope Responsibility: Own rule boundary, immutable AI result, evidence references, confidence, review queue, and failure retry.
Dependencies: Application; approved criteria; AI gateway
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer considers the advisory summary; Hiring Approver makes any configured progression decision.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may produce relevance flags only; it cannot qualify, reject, advance, or select.

What it does: A Hiring Reviewer reviews resume and AI evidence and records qualified, pending, or not-currently-qualified recommendation with required human rationale. A Hiring Approver makes the progression decision.
Request packet: AuditRequest; MessageRequest; getMessage request; NoticeRequest; askPerson request; ProposalRequest
Answer packet: AuditReceipt; MessageReceipt; Message; NoticeReceipt; askPerson answer; Proposal
How it maps to Steward: Assign the Hiring Reviewer task in Steward; create a Hiring Approver task when approval is required. HR drafts applicant-facing email with createMessage and treats it as sent only after getMessage confirms it.
HireScope Responsibility: Own recommendation/decision batches, internal note versus applicant-visible status, progression gate, and access restrictions.
Dependencies: AI evidence; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver authority; notification outbox
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer reviews and recommends. Hiring Approver makes the progression decision. HR communicates the approved applicant-visible status only.
AI responsibility and limits: AI provides advisory relevance evidence only. It cannot qualify, reject, advance, or select a candidate.

What it does: HR communicates the approved assessment invitation to a qualified candidate with start/deadline/duration, instructions, and a version-pinned assessment.
Steward Capability: createMessage/getMessage; notifyGuest for an active registered guest key
How it maps to Steward: Stage an external-contact invitation in Steward Out-Tray only where the candidate is an eligible contact. For a HireScope guest, notifyGuest is a delivered system notice; track approval/delivery separately from HireScope workflow state.
HireScope Responsibility: Own invitation state, attempt entitlement, time controls, version pinning, and delivery outbox/retry.
Dependencies: Hiring Approver decision; assessment config; communications contract; active guest key when notifyGuest is used
Human responsibility: Hiring Approver approves the stage before HR sends. HR sends and tracks the applicant invitation; the candidate decides whether to attempt it.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot send an invitation or change an applicant state.

What it does: Checks camera/microphone/connectivity where required for live-interview connectivity only (no video assessment or recording exists in this scope), captures informed consent, and provides an accessibility/accommodation path before attempt start.
How it maps to Steward: No consent/readiness API is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own consent record, readiness checks, candidate instructions, accessibility-safe states, and attempt-start gate.
Dependencies: Assessment invitation; accessibility policy
Human responsibility: The applicant provides consent and completes readiness steps; HR communicates support instructions.

What it does: Lets a candidate request an equivalent alternative. Hiring Reviewer sees the sensitive details, Hiring Approver decides the exception, and interviewers receive only required operational instructions. HR communicates the approved outcome.
Steward Capability: askPerson or createProposal can support reviewer/approver tasks; createAudit
How it maps to Steward: Assign private Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver tasks in Steward, limiting sensitive details to authorised reviewers.
HireScope Responsibility: Own accommodation record, least-privilege projection, recommendation/decision, configured equivalent path, communication outbox, and audit. Pause the no-response clock while a request is open.
Dependencies: Application; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver roles; privacy controls
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer assesses the request; Hiring Approver decides; HR communicates the result; interviewers receive only the implementation instructions.
AI responsibility and limits: AI must not see sensitive details and cannot decide an accommodation.

Feature: Treat an unattempted assessment as automatic cancellation
What it does: When an invited applicant neither attends nor submits the assessment by the configured deadline, HireScope opens a 24-hour in-product grievance window. The application is automatically cancelled/void only after the deadline passes and the 24-hour window ends with no grievance form submitted. The system actor, under the Owner-configured policy, applies the cancellation with reason code 'no attendance and no grievance within 24 hours'. A pending accommodation, suspension, withdrawal, or timely grievance prevents the cancellation. Any unfilled reservation is released only if present, and no automatic progression or reopening occurs.
How it maps to Steward: HireScope-owned: Append the automatic-cancellation audit and stage the applicant-visible outcome through the approved communications path.
HireScope Responsibility: Own deadline job, attendance/submission check, 24-hour grievance-window check, automatic cancellation/void state applied by the system under the Owner-configured policy with reason code 'no attendance and no grievance within 24 hours', conditional reservation release, immutable evidence trail, and HR communication outbox.
Dependencies: Assessment invitation; assessment attempt; grievance window; capacity transaction
Human responsibility: The candidate must submit the grievance form within 24 hours to prevent automatic cancellation. HR communicates the recorded outcome; no HR review/approval changes the automatic rule.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot cancel, void, or communicate.

What it does: Lets a no-response candidate submit a grievance form within the fixed 24-hour in-product window after an unattempted assessment. The only permitted outcome is retest eligibility.
How it maps to Steward: No Steward grievance-form capability is evidenced; HireScope owns the form.
HireScope Responsibility: Own the fixed 24-hour no-response grievance form, submission timestamp, and handoff to retest eligibility.
Dependencies: Unattempted assessment; 24-hour grievance window
Human responsibility: The candidate submits the grievance form within 24 hours. HR communicates the recorded outcome only.
AI responsibility and limits: AI cannot file or decide a no-response grievance.

Feature: Decide retest eligibility after timely grievance
What it does: After automatic cancellation is prevented by a timely grievance, a Hiring Reviewer reviews the explanation and a Hiring Approver may approve a six-month retest eligibility date. This creates a later linked replacement application for an eligible open position and never reopens the original application. The original application moves to a closed terminal state in every outcome.
Request packet: AuditRequest; MessageRequest; getMessage request; askPerson request; ProposalRequest
Answer packet: AuditReceipt; MessageReceipt; Message; askPerson answer; Proposal
How it maps to Steward: Assign Hiring Reviewer and Hiring Approver retest tasks in Steward and send the resulting applicant notice through Steward after the decision.
HireScope Responsibility: Own evidence reference, recommendation/decision, `retest_eligible_at`, duplicate/position checks, linked replacement application, original-application closed terminal state, access controls, and HR communication outbox.
Dependencies: Timely grievance; assessment attempt window; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver authority; evidence record; open position
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer assesses the timely grievance; Hiring Approver decides retest eligibility; HR communicates the decision.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may summarise a grievance only. It cannot decide eligibility or reopen an application.

What it does: Delivers version-pinned work sample, reading/spoken items, structured questions, timing, attempts, and required sections.
How it maps to Steward: No assessment delivery capability is evidenced.
HireScope Responsibility: Own attempt creation, timer, section/item rendering, response capture, and immutable version references.
Dependencies: Readiness; assessment configuration; media storage
Human responsibility: The applicant starts the permitted attempt after consent and readiness checks.

What it does: Captures each answer and media version within permitted retry rules; final submission is immutable.
Steward Capability: sendOutside may relay approved media/transcription service
How it maps to Steward: Use relay only for an approved external processor; HireScope remains system of record for submission and media metadata.
HireScope Responsibility: Own response/media records, upload security, retry limits, final lock, and audit.
Dependencies: Assessment attempt; secure media storage
Human responsibility: The applicant submits responses; authorised staff access only the permitted final evidence.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may process approved media only; it cannot edit or submit a response.

What it does: Lets a candidate report a technical interruption during an attempt; locks the affected attempt for Hiring Reviewer review and Hiring Approver decision. The outcome may be a reattempt, decided by the Hiring Approver after a Hiring Reviewer recommendation.
Request packet: askPerson request; AuditRequest; MessageRequest; getMessage request
How it maps to Steward: Create private reviewer/approver tasks for the grievance and use Steward audit/message primitives for the outcome.
HireScope Responsibility: Own technical-interruption grievance policy/window, evidence, locked state, recommendation/decision, reattempt, and HR applicant-message outbox.
Dependencies: Attempt; Hiring Reviewer/Hiring Approver authority; notification outbox
Human responsibility: Hiring Reviewer assesses the grievance; Hiring Approver decides reattempt or other exception; HR communicates the outcome.
AI responsibility and limits: AI may summarise submitted evidence only. It cannot decide a grievance or reattempt.

What it does: Compares permitted speech baselines defined in the approved assessment configuration against submitted audio for advisory integrity flagging, with an accommodation exemption for speech or accent differences; cannot auto-fail or decide progression.
How it maps to Steward: Use approved AI/service relay where needed; retain provider failure/correlation data.
